question_text: A 17-year-old teenager presents to the clinic with her parents complaining of headaches and loss of vision which began insidiously 3 months ago. Blood work is collected and an MRI is performed (the result is shown). Inhibition of which of the following hormones is the most likely explanation for the patient's signs and symptoms?
